card.stem: The new house has a concrete-block external wall: 16 mm external render, 100 mm outer concrete-block leaf, a 250 mm cavity FULLY filled with polystyrene bead insulation, 100 mm inner concrete-block leaf and 12 mm internal plaster. Rse = 0.048 and Rsi = 0.122 m²·°C/W. Conductivities in W/(m·°C): render 0.720; both concrete-block leaves 1.440; polystyrene bead 0.031; plaster 0.220. For EACH house, external wall area is 150 m², average inside temperature 20 °C and outside 6 °C. Heating runs 8 hours/day, every day, for 35 weeks/year. Oil costs €0.95/litre and provides 37,350 kJ/litre; 1,000 W = 1 kJ/s. Part (a) calculates the new wall U-value; part (b) calculates annual wall heat-loss cost for BOTH the new house using (a) and an existing house with U = 0.21 W/(m²·°C). Part (c) details water exclusion at the new house’s window head. The existing-house compliance statement belongs to the 2015 paper, not a current regulatory claim.
card.questionText: Calculate the U-value of the specified full-fill insulated external wall of the new house, showing the component resistances, total resistance and U-value.

rows.contextNote: Use a clear resistance table or equivalent method. Convert layer thicknesses from mm to m; R = thickness/conductivity, add both surface resistances and all five material layers, then U = 1/Rtotal. The rubric heading “Insulated concrete ground floor” is a source error: the paper and the worked solution describe the specified external wall.

Two separately published checks at 3 marks each. Use the supplied external surface resistance Rse = 0.048 m²·°C/W directly; do not divide it by a thickness or conductivity. Use the supplied internal surface resistance Rsi = 0.122 m²·°C/W directly.

Five separately published material-resistance checks at 3 marks each; retain both concrete-block leaves. Rrender = 0.016/0.720 = 0.02222222 m²·°C/W. Router block = 0.100/1.440 = 0.06944444 m²·°C/W. The outer and inner block leaves each contribute their own resistance. Rbead = 0.250/0.031 = 8.06451613 m²·°C/W. The cavity is fully filled: do not add a separate air-cavity resistance. Rinner block = 0.100/1.440 = 0.06944444 m²·°C/W. Include this second leaf as well as the outer leaf. Rplaster = 0.012/0.220 = 0.05454545 m²·°C/W.

U = 1/Rtotal = 1/8.45017269 = 0.11834078 W/(m²·°C), approximately 0.1183 W/(m²·°C). The rubric awards 1 mark for the formula alone within this 3-mark criterion, not an additional mark. The remaining criteria stay at their own published 3-mark allocations.
